_comment: Single source of truth for run_urban_workflows.ps1 and verify_repository_health.py. Paths are repo-root-relative. 'env' names a conda environment under %USERPROFILE%/anaconda3/envs (override with -PythonExe). 'training: true' targets refuse to run without -AllowTraining. 'defaultArgs' apply when -Args is not given.

MDWD-EDA.description: Full MDWD exploratory data analysis (tables + figures to Documents/MDWD-EDA).

MDWD-EDA-Notebook.description: MDWD EDA notebook, executed headlessly to a timestamped copy.

MTSD-EDA.description: MTSD EDA notebook (image inventory, EXIF/GPS, annotation analysis).

MDWD-YOLO12-Notebook.description: MDWD YOLO12 model-scale benchmark - RUNS TRAINING (RUN_TRAINING=True in the notebook).

MDWD-YOLO26-Notebook.description: MDWD YOLO26 model-scale benchmark - RUNS TRAINING.

MTSD-Prepare-Detection-Dataset.description: Builds Datasets/MTSD/Prepared/{MTSD-YOLO,MTSD-COCO} from QA annotations (~2 GB; overwrite-protected internally).

MTSD-YOLO12-Notebook.description: MTSD YOLO12 benchmark - training notebook (ships with RUN_TRAINING=False; flip it before a real run).

MTSD-YOLO26-Notebook.description: MTSD YOLO26 benchmark - training notebook (RUN_TRAINING=False by default).

MTSD-RFDETR-Notebook.description: MTSD RF-DETR benchmark - training notebook (RUN_TRAINING=False by default).

PromptDetect-App.description: Launches the interactive PromptDetect Gradio app (long-running server; stop with Ctrl+C).

PromptDetect-BatchEval.description: PromptDetect batch evaluation. Default args are a safe dry-run; pass -Args for a real run.

GDPR-Compliance.description: GDPR redaction tool. Default shows help (its 'preview' loads SAM 3.1); e.g. -Args 'preview --limit 5 --backend classic'.

Inference-Benchmark.description: Deployment/inference-speed benchmark. Default lists the model inventory; pass -Args for a benchmark run.

MTSD-AnnotationQA-Scan.description: Read-only MTSD annotation audit (writes a timestamped report folder).

Final-Dataset-Integrity.description: Dissertation-ready dataset integrity report for MDWD + MTSD (read-only).

Export-Dissertation-Tables.description: Consolidates existing result files into Documents/Final-Tables (timestamped).

MDWD-Leakage-Sensitivity.description: MDWD split-leakage sensitivity report (audit-only by default; pass -Args '--run-inference --models best-per-family' to re-evaluate checkpoints on leakage-clean valid/test subsets).

Failure-Case-Sampler.description: Error-analysis image sampler (FP/FN/duplicate/low-conf). Needs -Args, e.g. '--dataset PromptDetect --latest'.
